meaning:
σύν-δεσμος, -ου, ὁ
(συνδέω), [in LXX for קֶשֶׁר, קְטַר, etc. ;]
that which binds together, a bond: of the ligaments of the body, Col.2:19. Metaphorical, σ. ἀδικίας, Act.8:23; τ. τελειότητος, Col.3:14; τ. εἰρήνης, Eph.4:3 (see Lft., Col., ll. with).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”
being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.
